notes.title: "Bounce or Die" Re-Release and Postmortem
notes.content:
Hey there, it’s that time again - time for a new DevLog!  This one’s a postmortem on my first ever released game!

I break down my experience creating and releasing my first game to the public, a simple classic arcade-style game called "Bounce or Die."  I also touch on my first game creation attempts using The Games Factory.

[previewyoutube=6tlslHApK64;full][/previewyoutube]

Along with the postmortem, I’ve re-released the game for [url=https://guineapigparkour.itch.io/bounce-or-die]the first time on Itch[/url]!  It hasn’t been available for several years.

[previewyoutube=APVl-x_xUBo;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks!  Until next time!

- Jeff
